params.body:
Found while writing the README (#8): `npm run check` calls `astro check`, but `@astrojs/check` was in neither package.json nor the lockfile, so the script could not run. Added `@astrojs/check` and `typescript` as dev dependencies. `npm run check` now runs: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 2 hints. Tests still pass.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
params.title: npm run check can run
